superPowers.name: Descendant of the Faltine
superPowers.body: |*Action|: This character gains 3 |!power|. Roll 5 dice. If the roll contains any |!failure| results, this character suffers 2 |!damage|. This superpower can be used only once per Turn.

superPowers.name: Oshtur‘s Mighty Hand
superPowers.body: Choose an interactive terrain feature or an enemy character, both of |!size| 2 or less and within |!range| 3, and Throw it |!range_small|. This superpower can be used only once per Turn.

superPowers.name: Vapors of Dormammu
superPowers.body: Choose this character or another allied character within |!range| 4 and Place it within |!range| 2 of its current position. A character can be Placed by this superpower only once per Turn.

superPowers.name: Talons of Farallah
superPowers.body: When this character or another allied character within |!range| 4 of this character makes an attack, during the |*Create Attack Dice Pool| step, this character may use this superpower. The attacker adds 2 dice to its attack roll. If that attack deals |!damage| and the defender has a |!threat| of 5 or more, after the attack is resolved, the defender gains the |§judgment§Judgment| special condition. This superpower can be used only once per Turn.

erratas.body: Stamina increased from 6 to 7 on Healthy side, and increased from 5 to 6 on Injured side.
Demon Claws of Denak's range increased from 3 to 4.
Stamina increased from 5 to 6 on the Healthy side
The Slow special rule for Icy Tendrils of Ikthalon now triggers on |!hit| instead of |!wild|
The Stagger special rule for Icy Tendrils of Ikthalon now triggers on |!critical| |!wild| |!hit| instead of |!critical| |!wild| |!hit| |!block|
Descendant of the Faltine now deals 2 |!damage| if there is at least 1 |!failure|, instead of 1 |!damage| for each |!failure|
Vapors of Dormammu can now Place other allied characters within |!range| 4 instead of 3
Talons of Farallah superpower was added
Alter ego changed from Clea to Clea Strange
